### Established by God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/established-god
Passage: Romans 13:1
Points:
- Jesus affirmed that earthly rulers possess legitimate jurisdiction over civic obligations.
- Scripture illustrates distinct roles and defined boundaries for civil and religious leadership.
- Secular and non-Christian governing authorities are ultimately instituted by God Himself.
- Submitting to governing authorities is fundamentally a way of honoring God.
- Civil government is a gift from God intended to protect society from chaos and anarchy.
